_about: Spell sprites for the stage, redrawn by ComfyUI from the concept boards in Concept/spellAnimations/ (img2img, NovaAnimeXL). Each is a quadrant of a board: tl, tr, bl or br. The render is light on black, so the sprite's alpha is its brightness and Godot draws it additively. Bolts point right (their flight turns them), so a board that drew one pointing left sets flip.

effects.prompt: violet arcane magic arrow projectile with trailing afterimages, star sparkles, purple and white light

animate.motion: the arcane arrowheads pulse and shimmer, the trailing afterimages flicker

effects.prompt: fireball projectile streaking to the right, swirling orange and yellow flames, embers trailing behind

animate.motion: the fireball flickers and churns, its flames trailing and whipping behind it

effects.prompt: ice crystal spear projectile pointing right, pale cyan shards and snowflakes trailing behind

animate.motion: the ice spear glints, frost shards and snowflakes stream off behind it

effects.prompt: golden lightning shard projectile pointing right, bright yellow sparks and streaks trailing behind

animate.motion: the golden lightning shard crackles, sparks and electric streaks flicker behind it

effects.prompt: radial arcane impact burst, glowing violet rune circle, four pointed star flare in the centre, purple shards flying outward

animate.motion: the arcane burst flashes outward, the violet rune ring spins and expands, shards fly out, then it fades away

effects.prompt: fire explosion impact, blossoming orange and yellow flame burst, embers flying outward

animate.motion: the fireball explosion billows outward, flames curling and swirling, then breaks apart into embers and fades away

effects.prompt: ice shatter impact, radial burst of pale blue ice crystals and snowflakes, white core flash

animate.motion: the ice burst shatters outward, crystals fly apart and spin, frost mist puffs out, then everything fades

effects.prompt: golden star burst impact, radiant eight pointed light flare, yellow sparks flying outward

effects.prompt: round magic circle seal seen face on, concentric glowing violet rings with runes and a four pointed star in the centre, thin elegant lines
effects._seal: Drawn from board 03's root dome at a high denoise, it came back a golden magic circle; kept, and made white so the shader can colour it per element.

swirling violet arcane vortex, spiral arms of purple light around a dark centre, glowing orbiting crystals

animate.motion: the vortex spins steadily, its spiral arms of light turning around the dark centre, crystals orbiting

_boards: Note: 02-wards-and-barriers.png holds the radial bursts and 03-radial-glyph-bursts.png the wards; the files' names and pictures are swapped, so the entries below follow the pictures.
_animate: An effect with `animate` also ships as a sheet of frames drawn by the video model (fx.py --animate): the picture pinned as the first frame (and the last, for a loop), the motion in words. BattleFX plays the sheet when it is there.
